codes.UNKNOWN: Cilad ayaa dhinaceena ka dhacday waana la diiwaangeliyay. Fadlan mar kale isku day ama sii Taageerada IT tixraaca.
codes.VALIDATION: Meelaha qaar ayaa u baahan sixid. Eeg meelaha la calaamadeeyay.
codes.UNAUTHENTICATED: Fadhigaagii wuu dhammaaday. Fadlan mar kale gal.
codes.PERMISSION_DENIED: Ma lihid ogolaansho aad tan ku samayso.
codes.MFA_REQUIRED: Marka hore xaqiiji koodhkaaga laba-tallaabo, kadibna mar kale isku day.
codes.REAUTH_REQUIRED: Xiriirkani wuu dhacay ama hore ayaa loo isticmaalay. Codso mid cusub.
codes.REAUTH_FAILED: Furaha sirta aad gelisay sax maaha.
codes.NOT_FOUND: Diiwaankaas lama helin. Waxaa laga yaabaa in la saaray.
codes.CONFLICT: Tani waxay ku dhacaysaa diiwaan jira (tusaale magac hore loo isticmaalay).
codes.DUPLICATE_SUBMISSION: Foomkan hadda ayaa la kaydinayaa. Fadlan wax yar sug.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Isku dayo aad u badan. Fadlan daqiiqad sug kadibna isku day.
codes.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Galitaanno badan oo fashilmay. Akoonkan waa la xiray {minutes} daqiiqo.
codes.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: Akoonkan waa la hakiyay. La xiriir maamulahaaga.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Iimaylka ama furaha sirta sax maaha. {remaining, plural, =0 {Akoonka hadda waa la xiray 15 daqiiqo.} one {# isku day ayaa kuu haray ka hor xiritaanka 15 daqiiqo.} other {# isku day ayaa kuu haray ka hor xiritaanka 15 daqiiqo.}}
codes.PASSWORD_WEAK: Furahaas sirta waa daciif. Isticmaal ugu yaraan 10 xaraf oo isugu jira xarfo, tirooyin ama calaamado.
codes.PASSWORD_BREACHED: Furahaas sirta waxa uu ka soo muuqday xog la xaday. Dooro mid kale.
codes.EMAIL_TAKEN: Akoon leh iimaylkan ayaa hore u jiray.
codes.PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION: Ma bixin kartid awood adiga aanad lahayn.
codes.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: Waa inuu had iyo jeer jiraa ugu yaraan hal Maamule Sare oo firfircoon.
codes.SELF_ACTION_FORBIDDEN: Tan kuma samayn kartid akoonkaaga. Weydii maamule kale.
codes.PROTECTED_ROLE: Doorka Maamulaha Sare waa ilaalisan yahay lamana beddeli karo lamana tirtiri karo.
codes.ROLE_IN_USE: Doorkan wali waxaa haysta {detail} isticmaale. Marka hore u wareeji door kale.
codes.SYSTEM_ROLE: Doorarka nidaamka wax waa laga beddeli karaa laakiin lama tirtiri karo. Isticmaal "Ku celi asalka".
codes.HAS_RECORDS: Isticmaalahan wuxuu leeyahay diiwaanno sharci ama maaliyadeed, sidaa darteed waa la hakin karaa ama si jilicsan ayaa loo tirtiri karaa oo keliya.
codes.DISTRICT_OUT_OF_SCOPE: Waxaad bixin kartaa oo keliya degmooyinka adiga aad maamusho.
codes.SETUP_ALREADY_DONE: Dejinta hore ayaa loo dhammaystiray. Gal halkii.
codes.GOOGLE_NO_STAFF_ACCOUNT: Ma jiro akoon shaqaale oo leh iimaylkan Google. Weydii maamule inuu mid kuu sameeyo.
codes.MAKER_CHECKER: Adiga ayaa sameeyay diiwaankan, sidaa darteed qof kale ayaa ansixin doona.
codes.SESSION_EXPIRED: Waa lagaa saaray kadib muddo aadan waxba qaban. Fadlan mar kale gal.

users.title: Isticmaalayaasha
users.subtitle: Akoonnada shaqaalaha, doorarka iyo gelitaanka degmooyinka.
users.newSubtitle: Samee akoon shaqaale. Isbeddel kasta waxaa lagu diiwaangeliyaa diiwaanka hubinta.
users.emptyBody: Beddel shaandhaynta ama samee isticmaale cusub.
users.emailHint: Cinwaan kasta wuu shaqeeyaa, oo ay ku jirto Gmail.
users.rolesHelp: Isticmaale wuxuu yeelan karaa doorar badan. Doorarka u baahan awood aadan lahayn waa xiran yihiin.

security.title: Amni & xaalad
security.subtitle: Ficillada halkan isla markiiba ayay dhaqan galaan waxaana lagu diiwaangeliyaa diiwaanka hubinta.
security.selfNote: Ficillada qaar laguma samayn karo akoonkaaga.
security.passwordBody: Deji fure ku meel gaar ah oo cusub, ama u dir xiriir dib-u-dejin.
security.setPasswordBody: Isticmaalaha waa laga saarayaa meel kasta waana inuu beddelo furahan galitaanka xiga. Waxaa lagu koobiyeeyay clipboard-kaaga.
security.mfaOn: 2FA waa shidan tahay. Dib u deji haddii isticmaaluhu lumiyay telefoonkiisa.
security.signoutBody: Hadda ka saar isticmaalaha qalab kasta.
security.suspendBody: Isla markiiba wuu joojinayaa galitaanka. Taariikhda waa la hayaa, akoonkana dib ayaa loo furi karaa.
security.reactivateBody: U ogolow isticmaalahan inuu mar kale galo.
security.deleteBody: Tirtirka jilicsan wuxuu hayaa taariikhda. Tirtirka buuxa waa suurtagal oo keliya marka aysan jirin diiwaanno sharci ama maaliyadeed.
security.deleteConfirmBody: Dooro sida loo tirtirayo akoonkan, kadib ku xaqiiji furahaaga sirta.
security.softDeleteBody: Akoonka waxaa lagu calaamadeeyaa la tirtiray waana la xiraa. Diiwaannada iyo taariikhda waa la hayaa.
security.hardDeleteBody: Gebi ahaanba wuxuu saarayaa akoonka wuxuuna xorayaa iimaylka. Maamulaha Sare oo keliya.
security.hardDeleteBlocked: Lama heli karo: Maamulaha Sare oo keliya ayaa tirtiri kara si buuxda, oo keliya isticmaalayaasha aan lahayn diiwaanno sharci ama maaliyadeed.
security.yourPasswordHint: Ficillada xasaasiga ah waxay mar kale u baahan yihiin furahaaga.
security.deletedBody: Ma geli karo. Taariikhda waxaa lagu hayaa diiwaanka hubinta.

roles.title: Doorarka & ogolaanshaha
roles.subtitle: Doorarku waa xog: samee, koobiyee oo wax ka beddel goor kasta. Isticmaaluhu wuxuu helaa isugeynta doorarkiisa.
roles.newSubtitle: Dooro waxa saxda ah ee doorkani qaban karo iyo xogta uu arki karo.
roles.deleteBody: Tan dib looma celin karo. Tirtirka waxaa lagu diiwaangeliyaa diiwaanka hubinta.
roles.deleteInUse: {count, plural, one {# isticmaale ayaa wali haysta} other {# isticmaale ayaa wali haysta}} doorkan.
roles.moveHelp: Dooro door aad u wareejiso. Waa la wareejinayaa doorkana waa la tirtirayaa hal tallaabo.
roles.systemRoleNote: Door nidaam — wax waa laga beddeli karaa ama dib loogu celin karaa, laakiin lama tirtiri karo.
roles.protectedBody: Doorka Maamulaha Sare had iyo jeer wuxuu leeyahay ogolaansho kasta lamana beddeli karo lamana tirtiri karo.
roles.scopeHelp: Diiwaannada ay arki karaan kuwa haysta doorkan. Doorar badan marka la haysto, baaxadda ugu ballaaran ayaa shaqaysa.
roles.scopeHelp_own: Oo keliya diiwaannada ay sameeyeen ama leeyihiin.
roles.scopeHelp_districts: Diiwaannada dhammaan degmooyinka isticmaalaha loo qoondeeyay.

roles.resetBody: Soo celi ogolaanshihii asalka ahaa ee doorkan nidaamka. Kuwa haysta doorkan waa la ogeysiinayaa.

permissionsPage.title: Liiska ogolaanshaha

locations.subtitle: Kala-horreynta goobaha meel walba laga isticmaalo: degmooyin, qaybo, kaabo, xaafado, waddooyin iyo adeegyo, iyo xuduudahooda.
locations.emptyBody: Ku dar kan ugu horreeya, ama beddel shaandhaynta.
locations.name: Magac
locations.archiveBody: Waxay ka baxaysaa liisaska iyo khariidadda. Waxba lama tirtirayo waana la soo celin karaa.
locations.restoreBody: Mar kale ayay ka muuqan doontaa liisaska iyo khariidadda.
locations.codeHint: Xarfo waaweyn ama tirooyin, gaar u ah waalidka.
locations.codeHintNeighbourhood: Gaar u ah degmada — wuxuu noqonayaa qayb ka mid ah PUN kasta oo halkan ah.
locations.boundaryHelp: Soo geli fayl GeoJSON ah (dhererka/ballaca WGS84) ama ku dheji GeoJSON. Qaababka khaldan si toos ah ayaa loo saxayaa.
locations.geomError_geojson: Taasi ma aha GeoJSON sax ah.
locations.geomError_outside_Somalia: Qaabku Soomaaliya kuma jiro. Isku-duwayaashu waa inay noqdaan dherer, ballac (WGS84).

locations.help_sections: Qayb waxay ka tirsan tahay hal degmo.

locations.help_streets: Waddooyin magac leh oo xariiq ahaan loo sawiray.
locations.help_facilities: Dugsiyo, masaajido, isbitaallo iyo goobo kale oo guud.

applications.title: Codsiyada
applications.subtitle: Codsiyada diiwaangelinta, wareejinta iyo kuwa kale ee bogga, xafiiska iyo goobta.
applications.newSubtitle: Ku bilow waxa iyo meesha. Qabyada waa la kaydiyaa, markaas waad sii wadan kartaa.
applications.citizenNewSubtitle: Noo sheeg meesha hantidu ku taal. Codsigaaga waxaa loo kaydinayaa qabyo ilaa aad gudbiso.
applications.emptyBody: Beddel shaandhaynta ama bilow codsi cusub.
applications.neighbourhoodHint: Ku raadi magac ama koodh. Calaamad dhigiddu way buuxisaa.
applications.pinHint: Guji khariidadda meesha hantida, ama isticmaal GPS marka aad goobta joogto.
applications.pinNoNeighbourhood: Calaamaddu kuma jirto xaafad la sawiray.
applications.addressNoteHint: Calaamado ka caawiya sahamiyaha inuu helo dhulka.
applications.awaitingPaymentBody: Codsigu waa dhammaystiran yahay. Biilka khidmadda iyo lacag-bixinta mobilka waxay la imanayaan qaybta lacag-bixinta (wajiga 7); kadib lacag-bixinta wuxuu u gudbaa sahanka.
applications.ownersHelp: Qof kasta oo xaq u leh hantida. Saamiyada milkiilayaashu waa inay noqdaan 100%.
applications.citizenOwnersNote: Adiga ayaa milkiile ahaan loo qoray. Haddii ay jiraan milkiilayaal wadaag ah, xafiisku wuu ku dari doonaa xilliga hubinta.
applications.documentsHelp: PDF ama sawir, ilaa 10 MB midkiiba. Dukumentiyada qasabka ah waa la calaamadeeyay.
applications.reviewHelp: Sax wixii hoos ku qoran, kadib gudbi. Wax kama beddeli kartid kadib gudbinta ilaa xafiisku dib kuu celiyo.
applications.readyToSubmit: Wax kasta oo loo baahnaa waa diyaar.
applications.afterSubmitNote: Waxaad heli doontaa SMS leh lambarka. Goor kasta kala soco bogga raadraaca.
